name: researchstudio-web
description: The ResearchStudio Idea skills, ported to run anywhere web search is available: idea-spark (research direction to one reviewer-defensible idea card), paper-search, scoop-check (prior-art collision) and idea-quality (score an idea at the idea stage). The eleven reasoning system prompts are vendored byte-for-byte from a pinned microsoft/ResearchStudio commit and verified by verify_parity.py; retrieval is web search only, which is upstream's own lit_grounding_mode=webfallback made first-class. The same packages ship as .skill files for claude.ai in dist/.
